title: plantago coronopus var. ceratophylla
intro: Plantago coronopus var. ceratophylla, commonly known as Rock Plantain, is a plant species belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rock Plantain include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
